source.title: 9. Pharmacologic Approaches to Glycemic Treatment: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026
source.organization: American Diabetes Association Professional Practice Committee for Diabetes
source.source_type: clinical practice guideline chapter / Standards of Care section
source.working_copy_note: SHA-256 applies to the local working copy used for rendering and validation; the File Library/Drive source bytes were not directly mounted for hash comparison.

guideline_secondary_source_guardrail: Formal recommendations are represented as author_conclusion atoms with guideline_recommendation tags. Results from cited studies are represented as secondary-reported other atoms and are not serialized as if this guideline enrolled study participants.
schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind.
Recommendation evidence grades are preserved in tags rather than dedicated typed fields.
Secondary quantitative evidence from cited studies cannot be represented as primary quantitative_result atoms without fabricating primary-study population/exposure/outcome context.
source_gaps: README(2).md was not present among the supplied local project files.

The exact File Library/Drive source bytes were not directly mountable for hashing; a matching full-text working copy was used for rendering and text extraction, and the File Library source identity/content was independently located.
extraction_limitations: This is a guideline chapter, not primary empirical literature.
The bibliography was extracted to a separate reference task queue and was not atomized.
Full evidence-grading methodology is delegated by the source to the Standards introduction and methodology rather than reproduced in this chapter.
All atoms remain needs_review because no human source-verification step is represented.
No external practice, regulatory, or bibliographic verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
